# Agriwelt Docs

> Operator manuals and help for Agriwelt seeding systems: Hectare monitors (One, 5, Mini) and the Agrigate system. Every topic below is also available as markdown at the same address with `.md` instead of `.html`.


## Hectare One

- [Whole manual as one file](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/llms-full.txt)
- [What the Hectare One system does](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/overview.md): The seeding control system with the Hectare One panel in one page — what it watches, what it drives, and what it records.
- [What is supplied](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/whats-supplied.md): The minimum system, the optional devices a machine can carry, and the cables that connect them.
- [Safety](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/safety.md): What the panel can set in motion, who may operate it and from where, and how to handle the panel itself. Read before the first switch-on.
- [The panel and its seven buttons](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/front-panel.md): What is on the front and on the back of the Hectare One, and what each of the seven buttons does.
- [Switching on](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/switching-on.md): What the panel does after power-on, which access level it starts at, and what a long splash screen means.
- [Menus, context menus, number pad and windows](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/interface-basics.md): The five things everything on the panel is done through — working screens, the main menu, the context menu of a device, the number pad, and the windows that ask or tell.
- [Quick start — getting ready and moving off](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/quick-start.md): The order of getting the machine ready, what to check before the field, what happens when you move off, and what to watch while working.
- [About the pictures in this manual](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/about-the-pictures.md): The screens in this manual were shot on a test bench. What on them belongs to the bench and not to your machine.
- [The home screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/home-screen.md): What every part of the home screen is — speed, indicators, area, rates, the section diagrams — on a drill standing still and on a planter at work.
- [The section diagram — columns, line and colours](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/section-diagram.md): How to read the columns of the home screen in the "Precise" and the "Flow" mode, and what the control line means.
- [Column colours and the four states of a section](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/section-states.md): What each colour and symbol of a column on the section diagram means, and the four combinations of control and product application a section can be in.
- [The home screen on different machines](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/home-screen-examples.md): The same panel on a planter, a drill and machines of 44 and 96 rows — standing still and at work — so you can recognise your own screen.
- [Indicators of the home screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/indicators.md): Every indicator of the home screen with all its states — what you see, what it means, what to do.
- [The second home screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/second-home-screen.md): The home screen for a machine without seed sensors — what is on it, how to open and close it, and what its chevrons and tiles do.
- [The working screens and how to move between them](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/working-screens.md): The four working screens in their circle, the second home screen beside it, and every way — button or swipe — to get from one to another.
- [The Table screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/table-screen.md): The readings of every section in figures — which tables your machine has, what each column means, and how to read the colours.
- [The Statistics screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/statistics-screen.md): The report of the work on each field, block by block and line by line — and the menu that chooses the field, saves the report and erases it.
- [The Motors screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/motors-screen.md): The dispenser electric motors and the tramline actuators of the machine, one tile each — how to read a tile and how to reach a motor's settings.
- [Change the target rate](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/set-the-target-rate.md): Raise or lower the rate the panel holds and guards, from the home screen, while seeding — with the buttons or by touch.
- [Lock product application by hand](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/lock-application-by-hand.md): Stop all product application with one long press, and start it again — what the lock does and how to see that it is on.
- [Set the alarm level automatically](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/set-the-alarm-level.md): Let the panel set the alarm level of the diagrams from the rate the machine really sows, instead of guessing it — grain drills in the "Flow" or "Hybrid" mode.
- [Take a sensor into or out of control](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/sensor-in-and-out-of-control.md): Stop the panel from watching one sensor — a section that is shut off, a broken sensor — and take it back later.
- [Zero the readings of the Table screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/zero-the-readings.md): Set the seed and fertilizer counters of the Table screen to zero — for a new field or a new seed lot — without touching the field statistics.
- [Fill the disks with seeds](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/fill-the-disks.md): Turn the seed disks of a planter with dispenser motors until every disk holds seed, so that sowing starts from the first metre — how to run it and read the result.
- [Set up the tramline rhythm](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/tramline-rhythm.md): What a tramline rhythm is, worked out for your drill and sprayer, and how to set it up on the panel step by step.
- [Move to the next tramline bout](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/next-tramline-bout.md): How the bout changes by itself at the headland, what it needs to do so, and how to change or correct it by hand.
- [Set the screen brightness](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/screen-brightness.md): Make the screen brighter, dimmer or automatic — one item in the Settings menu.
- [Work without the speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/work-without-speed-sensor.md): When the speed sensor fails in the field — finish the work on a simulated speed and control the application by hand.
- [Access levels](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/access-levels.md): The three access levels of the Hectare One, what each one allows, and how to switch between them.
- [Enable the Agronomist level](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/enable-agronomist-level.md): The steps, with the screen of each, to raise the access level to "Agronomist" or "Service" before changing settings, and to return to "Operator" afterwards.
- [The profile](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/profile.md): What the profile tells the panel, how to check it, what each profile item allows, and when the panel refuses a profile.
- [Save and load settings](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/save-and-load-settings.md): Keep a copy of all the settings of the current profile in the panel or on a memory card, and bring it back — for example to move one panel between implements.
- [The Settings menu](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/settings-menu.md): Every item of the panel's own "Settings" menu — brightness, volume, language, alarm delay, diagram settings, date and time — with its range and access level.
- [Seeding machine parameters](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/seeding-machine-parameters.md): The working width, the modes of seeding and fertilizing, the tramline, the mapping of sections to actuators, and the two calibrations that need the machine to move.
- [Sensor settings](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/sensor-settings.md): How to reach the settings of one sensor, what its context menu holds, and which calibrations exist.
- [The sensor status screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/sensor-status-screen.md): How to read the status screen of a sensor — channel, address, type, link state, live figures and active alarms — and what each kind of sensor shows on it.
- [Travel speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/speed-sensor.md): The parameters of the travel speed sensor — pulses, wheel diameter, speed limits, imitation — and what setting the imitation does by itself.
- [Calibrate the speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/calibrate-speed.md): Drive a marked 100 m so that the panel corrects the pulse figure of the travel speed sensor.
- [Seed sensors and dry fertilizer sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/seed-and-fertilizer-sensors.md): The parameters shared by a group of optical seed or dry fertilizer sensors — target rates, fraction, sensitivity, rate error, skips and doubles, tramline tolerance.
- [Liquid fertilizer sensors and pump controller](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/liquid-fertilizer.md): The parameters of the liquid fertilizer section sensors and of the liquid fertilizer pump controller.
- [Dispenser shaft sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/dispenser-sensor.md): The parameters of the dispenser shaft sensor — rotation control against the wheel, or weight control by the mass applied.
- [Calibrate the dispenser rotation](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/calibrate-dispenser-rotation.md): Turn the drive wheel and the dispenser shaft together so that the panel learns how many shaft pulses belong to one wheel pulse.
- [Calibrate the dispenser by weight](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/calibrate-dispenser-weight.md): Turn a ground-driven dispenser into a container and weigh the product, so that the panel can watch the rate in kilograms per hectare.
- [Dispenser electric motor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/dispenser-motor.md): The parameters of an electric metering motor — gear ratio, direction, speed window, product, calibration figures and the calibration button.
- [Calibrate a metering motor by weight](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/calibrate-motor-weight.md): Let the electric motor turn the metering roller into a container and weigh the product, so that the panel knows how much one turn delivers.
- [Fan sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/fan-sensor.md): The parameters of the fan speed sensor — the allowed speed band and the pulses per turn.
- [Pressure sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/pressure-sensor.md): The parameters of the air pressure sensor — the smoothing filter and the allowed pressure band.
- [Marker sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/marker-sensors.md): The parameters of the marker sensors — which marker a sensor watches and which input state means "lowered".
- [Hopper, work position and engine sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/hopper-position-engine-sensors.md): The settings of the two-state sensors — hopper level, work position of the implement, and the five tractor engine sensors.
- [Tramline actuator](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/tramline-actuator.md): The two parameters of the tramline actuator, where the rest of its settings live, and what its status screen shows.
- [Device configuration — before you start](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/device-configuration.md): What device configuration is, the preparation it needs, and the three-item pattern every configuration menu follows.
- [Configure a seed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/configure-seed-sensor.md): Give a new or replaced seed sensor the number of its row.
- [Configure a pressure sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/configure-pressure-sensor.md): Give a new or replaced air pressure sensor its address.
- [Configure a HUB8](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/configure-hub8.md): Tell a HUB8 input device which sensor is wired to each of its eight channels.
- [Configure a tramline actuator controller](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/configure-tramline-actuator.md): Tell an actuator controller which tramline actuator it drives and which marker sensors are wired to it.
- [Configure the motor controllers](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/configure-motor-controllers.md): Give a metering motor controller its address, choose the kind of controller, and set its parameters.
- [Motor controller diagnostics](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/motor-controller-diagnostics.md): How to read what a metering motor controller reports about itself on the Motors screen — speed, error code, voltages, temperature, current, status bits and fault counters.
- [The Service menu](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/service-menu.md): Every item of the "Service" menu, its access level, and which ones an engineer should leave alone.
- [How alarms work](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/how-alarms-work.md): When the Hectare One raises an alarm, what the alarm window shows, how to close it, and how to use the alarm topics of this manual.
- [Any device: connection lost or wrong device type](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-any-device.md): The two alarms any sensor, actuator, controller or input device can raise — no answer from the device, or the wrong kind of device answering.
- [Fan or dispenser shaft: speed alarms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-rotation.md): What to do when the fan or the dispenser shaft turns too slowly, too fast, or not at all.
- [Hopper empty](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-hopper.md): What to do when the panel reports that a hopper is running empty.
- [Air pressure too high or too low](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-pressure.md): What to do when the pressure sensor of the air system reports a pressure or vacuum outside the allowed range.
- [Application rate too low, too high, or not under control](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-rate.md): What to do when the seed, dry fertilizer or liquid fertilizer sensors report a rate below or above the allowed band, or too little product to start control at all.
- [Too many doubles or skips](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-seeding-quality.md): What to do when a seed sensor of a precision planter counts more doubles or skips than allowed.
- [Tramline: actuator stalled or product in the tramline](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-tramline.md): What to do when the tramline actuator jams, its position sensors contradict each other, or a shut-off section still delivers product.
- [Seed or fertilizer sensor clogged, light-struck or broken](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-sensor-state.md): What to do when an optical seed or fertilizer sensor reports a blocked channel, too much light, a fault of its own, or outdated firmware.
- [Tractor engine: oil pressure, battery charge, fuel, air filter](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-tractor.md): What to do when one of the on-board engine sensors — oil pressure, battery charge, fuel level, air filter — raises an alarm.
- [Product rate by weight too low, too high, or impossible](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-dosing-by-weight.md): What to do when a product dosed by weight — by an electric motor or a weight-controlled dispenser — misses its target rate, or cannot reach it at all.
- [User is Agronomist: alarms will not be shown](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-access-level.md): Why the panel warns that alarms are hidden, and how to get them back.
- [Travel speed sensor failed, or speed limits contradict](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-speed-sensor.md): What to do when one of two speed sensors stops giving pulses, or when the minimum and maximum travel speed are set the wrong way round.
- [Metering motor: jammed, electrical faults, bootloader](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-motor-controller.md): What to do when the controller of a dispenser electric motor reports a jam, a short circuit, over-current, a wrong supply voltage, overheating or an unknown fault.
- [Liquid fertilizer pump: pressure and rate alarms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/alarms-pump-controller.md): What to do when the liquid fertilizer pump controller reports too much pressure, a failed pressure sensor, or a rate it cannot hold.
- [Read the fault code of an electric motor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/motor-fault-codes.md): Where the panel shows the numeric fault code of a metering motor controller, and what each code means.
- [Buttons and gestures on every screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/buttons-and-gestures.md): What each of the seven buttons and each touch gesture does — on the home screen, in menus, in windows, on the number pad and on every working screen.
- [Terms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/one/terms.md): The words this manual uses for rates, control, sensors, tramlines and devices — what each means on the Hectare One.

## Hectare 5

- [Whole manual as one file](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/llms-full.txt)
- [What the Hectare 5 system does](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/overview.md): The seeding control system with the Hectare 5 panel in one page — what it watches, what it drives, and what it records.
- [The panel and its touch screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/front-panel.md): What the Hectare 5 panel is made of from the operator's side — a touch screen without buttons — and what else is built into it.
- [Switching on](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/switching-on.md): What the panel does after power-on, which state it starts in, and what to wait for before switching off.
- [Menus, context menus, number pad and windows](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/interface-basics.md): The five things everything on the panel is done through — working screens, the main menu, the context menu of a device, the number pad, and the windows that ask or tell — and how each is worked by touch.
- [Quick start — getting ready and moving off](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/quick-start.md): The order of getting the machine ready, what to check before the field, what happens when you move off, and what to watch while working.
- [About the pictures in this manual](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/about-the-pictures.md): Which pictures of this manual are still to come, why the text stands without them, and what on a bench picture belongs to the bench and not to your machine.
- [The home screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/home-screen.md): What every part of the home screen is — speed, indicators, area, rates, the section diagrams — on a drill standing still and on a planter at work, and what you can do from it by touch.
- [The section diagram — columns, line and colours](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/section-diagram.md): How to read the columns of the home screen in the "Precise" and the "Flow" mode, and what the control line means.
- [Column colours and the four states of a section](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/section-states.md): What each colour and symbol of a column on the section diagram means, and the four combinations of control and product application a section can be in.
- [Indicators of the home screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/indicators.md): Every indicator of the home screen with all its states — what you see, what it means, what to do.
- [The built-in GPS receiver](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/gps.md): What the satellite symbol on the home screen tells you, how the panel can take the travel speed from GPS, and what happens when the signal is poor.
- [The second home screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/second-home-screen.md): The second home screen — what is on it, how to open and close it, and what its chevrons, tiles and symbols do when touched.
- [The working screens and how to move between them](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/working-screens.md): The four working screens in their circle, the second home screen beside it, and the swipes that get you from one to another — including the way back home from Table and Statistics.
- [The Table screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/table-screen.md): The readings of every section in figures — which tables your machine has, what each column means, and how to read the colours.
- [The Statistics screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/statistics-screen.md): The report of the work on each field, block by block and line by line — and the menu that chooses the field, saves the report and erases it.
- [The Motors screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/motors-screen.md): The dispenser electric motors and the tramline actuators of the machine, one tile each — how to read a tile and how to reach a motor's settings.
- [Change the target rate](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/set-the-target-rate.md): Raise or lower the rate the panel holds and guards, from the home screen, while seeding — by touch.
- [Lock product application by hand](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/lock-application-by-hand.md): Stop all product application with one touch and hold, and start it again — what the lock does and how to see that it is on.
- [Set the alarm level automatically](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/set-the-alarm-level.md): Let the panel set the alarm level of the diagrams from the rate the machine really sows, with one double tap — grain drills in the "Flow" or "Hybrid" mode.
- [Take a sensor into or out of control](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/sensor-in-and-out-of-control.md): Stop the panel from watching one sensor — a section that is shut off, a broken sensor — and take it back later.
- [Zero the readings of the Table screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/zero-the-readings.md): Set the seed and fertilizer counters of the Table screen to zero — for a new field or a new seed lot — without touching the field statistics.
- [Fill the disks with seeds](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/fill-the-disks.md): Turn the seed disks of a planter with dispenser motors until every disk holds seed, so that sowing starts from the first metre — how to run it and read the result.
- [Set up the tramline rhythm](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/tramline-rhythm.md): What a tramline rhythm is, worked out for your drill and sprayer, how to set it up on the panel by touch, and how the panel counts the bouts.
- [Set the screen brightness](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/screen-brightness.md): Make the screen brighter or dimmer — one item in the Settings menu, set by hand.
- [Work without the speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/work-without-speed-sensor.md): When the speed sensor fails in the field — take the speed from GPS, or finish the work on a simulated speed and control the application by hand.
- [Access levels](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/access-levels.md): The three access levels of the Hectare 5, what each one opens, and what happens to the alarms while a higher level is set.
- [Enable the Agronomist level](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/enable-agronomist-level.md): The steps, by touch, to raise the access level to "Agronomist" or "Service" before changing settings, and to return to "Operator" afterwards.
- [The profile](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/profile.md): What the profile tells the panel, how to check it, what each profile item allows, when the panel refuses a profile, and how it is saved.
- [Save and load settings](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/save-and-load-settings.md): Keep a copy of the settings inside the panel and bring it back, and write the profile to a memory card.
- [The Settings menu](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/settings-menu.md): Every item of the panel's own "Settings" menu — brightness, volume, language, touch sound, diagram settings, date and time, alarm delay, access level — with its range, default and access level.
- [Seeding machine parameters](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/seeding-machine-parameters.md): The working width, the modes of seeding and fertilizing, the tramline, the relation of sections to actuators and motors, and the two calibrations that need the machine to move.
- [Sensor settings](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/sensor-settings.md): How to reach the settings of one sensor by touch, what its context menu holds, and which calibrations exist and where.
- [The sensor status screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/sensor-status-screen.md): How to read the status screen of a sensor — channel, address, type, link state, live figures and active alarms — what each kind of sensor shows on it, and how to move through it by touch.
- [Travel speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/speed-sensor.md): The parameters of the travel speed sensor — pulses, wheel diameter, factor, speed limits, imitation, the built-in GPS receiver — and what setting the imitation does by itself.
- [Calibrate the speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/calibrate-speed.md): Drive a marked 100 m so that the panel corrects the factor of the travel speed sensor.
- [Seed sensors and dry fertilizer sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/seed-and-fertilizer-sensors.md): The parameters shared by a group of optical seed or dry fertilizer sensors — fraction, sensitivity, rate error, skips and doubles, percent of sowing, tramline tolerance — and the per-sensor switch for product application.
- [Liquid fertilizer sensors and pump controller](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/liquid-fertilizer.md): The parameters of the liquid fertilizer section sensors and of the liquid fertilizer pump controller, with their ranges and defaults.
- [Dispenser shaft sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/dispenser-sensor.md): The parameters of the dispenser shaft sensor — rotation control against the wheel, or weight control by the mass applied — with ranges and defaults.
- [Calibrate the dispenser rotation](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/calibrate-dispenser-rotation.md): Turn the drive wheel and the dispenser shaft together so that the panel learns how many shaft pulses belong to the wheel pulses.
- [Calibrate the dispenser by weight](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/calibrate-dispenser-weight.md): Turn a ground-driven dispenser into a container and weigh the product, so that the panel can watch the rate in kilograms per hectare.
- [Dispenser electric motor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/dispenser-motor.md): The parameters of an electric metering motor — holes in the disk, gear ratio, direction, jam rollback, product, calibration figures, speed window and calibration button — with ranges, defaults and when each is shown.
- [Calibrate a metering motor by weight](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/calibrate-motor-weight.md): Let the electric motor turn the metering roller into a container and weigh the product, so that the panel knows how much one turn delivers.
- [Fan sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/fan-sensor.md): The parameters of the fan speed sensor — the allowed speed band and the pulses per turn — with ranges and defaults.
- [Pressure sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/pressure-sensor.md): The parameters of the air pressure sensor — the smoothing filter and the allowed pressure band — with ranges, defaults and when the band is watched.
- [Marker sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/marker-sensors.md): The parameters of the marker sensors — which marker a sensor watches and which input state means "lowered".
- [Hopper, work position and engine sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/hopper-position-engine-sensors.md): The settings of the two-state sensors — hopper level, work position of the implement, and the five sensors of the fan-drive engine.
- [Tramline actuator](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/tramline-actuator.md): The two parameters of the tramline actuator, where the rest of its settings live, and what its status screen shows.
- [Device configuration — before you start](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/device-configuration.md): What device configuration is, the preparation it needs, and the three-item pattern every configuration menu follows.
- [Configure a seed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/configure-seed-sensor.md): Give a new or replaced seed sensor the number of its row.
- [Configure a pressure sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/configure-pressure-sensor.md): Give a new or replaced air pressure sensor its address.
- [Configure a HUB8](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/configure-hub8.md): Tell a HUB8 input device — "Concentrator-8" on the screen — what is wired to each of its eight channels.
- [Configure a tramline actuator controller](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/configure-tramline-actuator.md): Tell an actuator controller which tramline actuator it drives and which marker sensors are wired to it.
- [Configure the motor controllers](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/configure-motor-controllers.md): Give a metering motor controller its address, choose the kind of controller, and set its parameters.
- [Motor controller diagnostics](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/motor-controller-diagnostics.md): How to read what a metering motor controller reports about itself on the Electric motors screen — speed, error code, voltages, temperature, current, status bits and fault counters — and how to move through it by touch.
- [The Service menu](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/service-menu.md): Every item of the "Service" menu, its access level, and which ones an engineer should leave alone.
- [How alarms work](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/how-alarms-work.md): When the Hectare 5 raises an alarm, what the alarm window shows, how it is closed by touch, which faults sound without a window, and how to use the alarm topics of this manual.
- [Any device: connection lost or wrong device type](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-any-device.md): The two alarms any sensor, actuator, controller or input device can raise — no answer from the device, or the wrong kind of device answering.
- [Fan or dispenser shaft: speed alarms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-rotation.md): What to do when the fan or the dispenser shaft turns too slowly, too fast, or not at all.
- [Hopper empty](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-hopper.md): What to do when the panel reports that a hopper is running empty.
- [Air pressure too high or too low](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-pressure.md): What to do when the pressure sensor of the air system reports a pressure or vacuum outside the allowed range.
- [Application rate too low or too high](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-rate.md): What to do when the seed, dry fertilizer or liquid fertilizer sensors report a rate below or above the allowed band, and what NOT UNDER CONTROL means.
- [Too many doubles or skips](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-seeding-quality.md): What to do when a seed sensor of a precision planter counts more doubles or skips than allowed.
- [Tramline: actuator stalled or product in the tramline](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-tramline.md): What to do when the tramline actuator jams, its position sensors contradict each other, or a shut-off section still delivers product.
- [Seed or fertilizer sensor clogged, light-struck or broken](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-sensor-state.md): What to do when an optical seed or fertilizer sensor reports a blocked channel, too much light, a fault of its own, or outdated firmware.
- [Engine: oil pressure, battery charge, fuel, air filter](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-tractor.md): What to do when one of the engine sensors — oil pressure, battery charge, fuel level, air filter — raises an alarm.
- [Product rate by weight too low, too high, or impossible](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-dosing-by-weight.md): What to do when a product dosed by weight — by an electric motor or a weight-controlled dispenser — misses its target rate, or cannot reach it at all.
- [User is Agronomist: alarms will not be shown](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-access-level.md): Why the panel warns that alarms are hidden, and how to get them back by touch.
- [Travel speed sensor failed, speed limits contradict, or poor GPS signal](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-speed-sensor.md): What to do when one of two speed sensors stops giving pulses, when the minimum and maximum travel speed are set the wrong way round, or when the built-in receiver sees too few satellites.
- [Metering motor: jammed, electrical faults, bootloader](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-motor-controller.md): What to do when the controller of a dispenser electric motor reports a jam, a short circuit, over-current, a wrong supply voltage, overheating, an unknown fault or a stuck firmware update.
- [Liquid fertilizer pump: pressure and rate alarms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/alarms-pump-controller.md): What to do when the liquid fertilizer pump controller reports too much pressure, a failed pressure sensor, or a rate it cannot hold.
- [Read the fault code of an electric motor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/motor-fault-codes.md): Where the panel shows the numeric fault code of a metering motor controller, and what each code means.
- [Touch zones and gestures on every screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/buttons-and-gestures.md): What each touch gesture does — on the home screen, the second home screen, the working screens, in menus, on the number pad and in windows.
- [Terms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/five/terms.md): The words this manual uses for gestures, rates, control, sensors, tramlines and devices — what each means on the Hectare 5.

## Hectare Mini

- [Whole manual as one file](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/llms-full.txt)
- [What the Hectare Mini system does](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/overview.md): The seeding control system with the Hectare Mini panel in one page — what it watches, what it drives, what it records, and who to ask.
- [The panel and its seven buttons](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/front-panel.md): What the Hectare Mini panel consists of, how it is mounted, and what each of the seven buttons does with a short and a long press.
- [Switching on and off](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/switching-on.md): What the Hectare Mini shows after power-on, which screen and access level it starts with, and when it is safe to switch off.
- [Screens, menus, context menus and windows](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/interface-basics.md): The things everything on the Hectare Mini is done through — the working screens, the menus, the context menu of a device, the windows that ask or tell, and the access levels.
- [The number pad](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/number-pad.md): How to type a number on the Hectare Mini — what the window shows, which buttons work, and the traps of an empty field and of values outside the range.
- [Quick start — before and during the first pass](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/quick-start.md): What to check before you drive into the field with the Hectare Mini, how the panel starts watching by itself, and what to look at during the first pass.
- [Commissioning — setting up a new system](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/commissioning.md): The order in which a new Hectare Mini system is set up on a machine — from connecting the devices to the calibrations — with a link to the details of every step.
- [About this manual and its pictures](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/about-the-pictures.md): How to read this manual — signal words, access levels, button presses — and what in the pictures belongs to the test bench and not to your machine.
- [The home screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/home-screen.md): What every part of the Hectare Mini home screen is — speed, indicators, area, population, the diagrams and rate fields — and what you can do from it.
- [Indicators of the home screen and their states](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/indicators.md): Every indicator of the Hectare Mini home screen in every state — speed, hopper, dispenser shaft, fan, pressure, engine sensors, implement position, markers, tramline, clock, area, population and product rates.
- [The section diagram — columns, lines and colours](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/section-diagram.md): How to read the seed and fertilizer diagrams of the Hectare Mini in the "Flow", "Hybrid" and "Precise" modes, and what "NOT UNDER CONTROL" means.
- [GPS reception and the GPS information screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/gps-receiver.md): How the Hectare Mini takes the travel speed from its built-in GPS receiver, what the colour of the satellite icon means, and how to read the GPS information screen.
- [The Seeding table screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/table-screen.md): The readings of every seed line as figures, one row per line — which tables your machine has, what each column and colour means, and how to zero the readings.
- [The Statistics screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/statistics-screen.md): The report of the work on each field, block by block — and the menu that chooses the active field, shows the lifetime mileage and erases a field.
- [The rate control screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/rate-control-screen.md): The screen for machines that apply products to a rate — what it shows, its three states, its colours, and how to reach the motors and their calibration from it.
- [The Motors screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/motors-screen.md): One tile per dispenser motor and one symbol per tramline actuator — how to reach the screen, read the colours, take a motor out of control and open its settings.
- [Change the target rate or the alarm level](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/set-the-target-rate.md): Raise or lower the alarm level, the target rate in seeds per metre or the product rate in kg/ha — on the home screen or on the rate control screen.
- [Set the alarm level of a grain drill](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/set-the-alarm-level.md): Let the Hectare Mini set the alarm level from the flow being applied, with one long press — or set it by hand — so that a line that loses flow is reported.
- [Lock product application by hand](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/lock-application-by-hand.md): Stop the dispenser motors and the liquid pump with one long press, so that nothing turns while you work on the machine — and how the panel shows the lock.
- [Take a sensor into or out of control](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/sensor-in-and-out-of-control.md): Switch the watching of a single sensor, motor or actuator off and on with the sensor setup mode — what the panel asks, and when it wants the statistics erased.
- [Zero the readings of the Seeding table](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/zero-the-readings.md): Set the counters and interval figures of the Seeding table to zero — what is zeroed, what is not, and what else zeroes them.
- [Start work on a new field](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/start-a-new-field.md): Choose the field the panel writes its statistics to, and erase it if it is not empty — before the first pass on a new field.
- [Fill the disks with seeds](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/fill-the-disks.md): Turn the seed disks of a planter with dispenser motors until every disk holds seed, so that sowing starts from the first metre — how to run it and read the result.
- [Assign a product to a dispenser motor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/assign-product-to-motor.md): Tell the panel which of its three products each dispenser motor applies, so that one target rate in kg/ha serves all motors of that product.
- [Calibrate a dispenser motor by weight](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/calibrate-motor-weight.md): Tell the panel how much product a motor-driven dispenser delivers per shaft turn — what you need, the steps on the screen, and what the failure messages mean.
- [Set up the tramline rhythm](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/tramline-rhythm.md): Tell the Hectare Mini on which bouts which actuator or motor shuts off — the limits, the rhythm editor, its dialogs, and the order that keeps your rhythm from being overwritten.
- [Tramline in the field — bout indicator and next bout](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/next-tramline-bout.md): Read the tramline indicator, move to the next bout by hand or let the panel do it from the markers or the implement position, and recognise a line shut off for the tramline.
- [Access levels](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/access-levels.md): The three access levels of the Hectare Mini — Operator, Agronomist, Service — what each one opens, what happens to the alarms at the higher levels, and how to get back to Operator.
- [Enable the Agronomist level](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/enable-agronomist-level.md): The steps, with the screen of each, to raise the access level of the Hectare Mini to "Agronomist" or "Service" before changing settings, and to return to "Operator" afterwards.
- [Check the profile and the connections](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/check-profile-and-connections.md): The first check after installing a Hectare Mini — does the profile match the machine, does every device answer, is every sensor under control — as a procedure with what the screen shows at each step.
- [The profile](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/profile.md): What the profile of the Hectare Mini is, every item of the profile menu with its values, and the rules a profile must keep before the panel accepts it.
- [Set up the profile](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/set-up-the-profile.md): The steps to change the profile of the Hectare Mini — reach the profile menu at the Service level, enter the devices of the machine, save, and let the panel restart.
- [The Settings menu](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/settings-menu.md): Every item of the Settings menu of the Hectare Mini — sound, language, diagram settings, date and time, alarm delay, product rate error, machine parameters, user — with its access level, range and default.
- [Set the date and time](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/set-date-and-time.md): Set the clock of the Hectare Mini by hand, or let it follow the GPS receiver with a time zone.
- [Seeding machine parameters](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/seeding-machine-parameters.md): The submenu with the working width and the control modes of the Hectare Mini, what changing them does to the statistics, and where the two menu calibrations start.
- [Sensor settings](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/sensor-settings.md): How to reach the settings of one sensor of the Hectare Mini, what every context menu holds, which settings are shared by a group, and which calibrations exist.
- [The sensor status screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/sensor-status-screen.md): How to read the status screen of a Hectare Mini sensor — type, unit, link, live figures and active alarms — and what each kind of sensor shows on it.
- [Travel speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/speed-sensor.md): Every parameter of the travel speed sensor of the Hectare Mini — pulses, count period, wheel diameter, factor, seeding criteria, speed limits, imitation — with its range and default.
- [Calibrate the speed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/calibrate-speed.md): Drive a marked 100 m so that the Hectare Mini corrects the factor of the travel speed sensor — started from the Seeding machine parameters or from the context menu of the sensor.
- [Seed and fertilizer sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/seed-and-fertilizer-sensors.md): The settings of the seed sensors and the fertilizer sensors of the Hectare Mini — fraction for the crop, correction, error limits, recalculation path, percent of sowing — and when the panel starts to control the seeding.
- [Let the panel calculate the recalculation path](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/recalculation-path.md): Let the Hectare Mini work out the best "Recalculation,m" for skips and doubles from the target rate and the holes in the disk — with or without dispenser motors.
- [Dispenser shaft sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/dispenser-sensor.md): The settings of a dispenser shaft sensor of the Hectare Mini — the period for "No rotation", the control of the shaft speed against the travel speed, and the control of the product weight — with ranges and defaults.
- [Calibrate the dispenser rotation](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/calibrate-dispenser-rotation.md): Turn the drive wheel so that the Hectare Mini learns how many dispenser pulses go with how many wheel pulses — needed before "Rotation speed control" can watch the shaft speed.
- [Calibrate the dispenser by weight](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/calibrate-dispenser-weight.md): Turn the dispenser into a container and weigh it, so that the Hectare Mini knows how much product one turn of the shaft applies — needed for "Weight control".
- [Fan sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/fan-sensor.md): The settings of a fan speed sensor of the Hectare Mini — minimum and maximum fan speed and pulses per revolution — and when the panel raises its alarms.
- [Pressure sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/pressure-sensor.md): The settings of a pressure (vacuum) sensor of the Hectare Mini — filter, minimum and maximum pressure — and when the panel raises its alarms.
- [Hopper and work position sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/hopper-and-work-position-sensors.md): The hopper level sensor of the Hectare Mini, which has no settings, and the work position sensor with its transport signal and its alarm criterion.
- [Engine sensors of the fan drive](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/engine-sensors.md): The five sensors of a separate fan-drive engine on the Hectare Mini — ignition, emergency oil pressure, battery charge, low fuel, air filter — their two settings and how the ignition sensor gates the others.
- [Marker sensors](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/marker-sensors.md): The two settings of the marker arm sensors of the Hectare Mini — which arm a single sensor watches, and which signal means "down".
- [Device configuration](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/device-configuration.md): What device configuration on the Hectare Mini is for, and how to prepare it — only the one device on the harness, the Agronomist level, the Sensors Configuration menu.
- [Configure a seed sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/configure-seed-sensor.md): Give a new or replaced seed sensor of the Hectare Mini the number of its row — how to hold an open sensor, the three menu items, and the check afterwards.
- [Configure a pressure sensor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/configure-pressure-sensor.md): Give a new or replaced pressure sensor of the Hectare Mini its address — the three menu items and the check afterwards.
- [Configure a HUB-8 concentrator](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/configure-hub8.md): Set the eight channels of a HUB-8 concentrator on the Hectare Mini — what each channel stands in for, and the shortcuts that fill all channels at once.
- [How alarms work](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/how-alarms-work.md): When the Hectare Mini raises an alarm, what the alarm window shows, how to close it, which messages are not alarm windows, and how the alarm topics of this manual are organised.
- [Device does not answer: Connection lost, Wrong device type!](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-any-device.md): The two alarms every sensor, motor or actuator of the Hectare Mini can raise — no answer from the device, or an answer from the wrong kind of device — and what to check.
- [Travel speed: SLOWER, FASTER and speed sensor alarms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-speed-sensor.md): What to do when the Hectare Mini shows SLOWER or FASTER, when a speed sensor fails, or when the speed limits cannot be met.
- [Seeding alarms: rate, skips, doubles, NOT UNDER CONTROL](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-seeding.md): What to do when a seed or fertilizer line of the Hectare Mini sows too little or too much, has too many skips or doubles, sows into a tramline — or when the panel is not controlling at all.
- [Seed sensor state: Clogged, Light struck, Broken](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-sensor-state.md): What to do when a seed or fertilizer sensor of the Hectare Mini reports that its optical channel is blocked, that it is blinded by sunlight, or that it has failed.
- [Fan or dispenser shaft: speed alarms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-rotation.md): What to do when the fan or a dispenser shaft of the Hectare Mini turns too slowly, too fast, or not at all.
- [Hopper empty](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-hopper.md): What to do when the Hectare Mini reports that a hopper is empty.
- [Pressure alarms: High pressure, Low pressure](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-pressure.md): What to do when the vacuum measured by a pressure sensor of the Hectare Mini is too high or too low.
- [Engine alarms: oil pressure, battery charge, fuel, air filter](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-engine.md): What to do when a sensor of the separate fan-drive engine of the Hectare Mini reports low oil pressure, no battery charge, low fuel or a dirty air filter.
- [Dosing by weight: product rate too low or too high](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-dosing-by-weight.md): What to do when the Hectare Mini reports that a product dosed by weight is applied below or above its target rate, or cannot be dosed at all.
- [User is Agronomist! Alarms will not be shown!](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-access-level.md): The one window the Hectare Mini still shows at the Agronomist or Service level when seeding starts — what it means and how to get the alarms back.
- [Tramline alarms: Illegal state, Stall](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-tramline.md): What to do when a tramline actuator of the Hectare Mini reports both end positions at once, does not reach its position, or when seed passes a line shut off for a tramline.
- [Dispenser motor alarms](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/alarms-electric-motors.md): What the alarms of an electric dispenser motor of the Hectare Mini mean — voltage, temperature, short circuit, current, jamming — and what to check.
- [The context menu of a dispenser motor](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/motor-context-menu.md): Every item of the context menu of a dispenser electric motor — what it sets, from which access level it is visible, and what "Reset to defaults" really resets.
- [Buttons on every screen](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/buttons-and-gestures.md): What each of the seven buttons does with a short and a long press — and where the screen takes touches — on the home screen, in menus, in windows and on every working screen.
- [Terms used in this manual](https://docs.agriwelt.com/en/mini/terms.md): The words of the Hectare Mini manual in one place — from active field and alarm level to singulation, spacing and tramline rhythm.
